title: One object (map/objects/<kind>/original/<name>.json, map/objects/<kind>/custom/<name>.json)
description: One object of a kind with its entries in both packed files (docs/object-folders-spec.md, section 2), read and written by crates/w3proj/src/object_layout.rs. The file name is a function of the id (the base in original/): the id itself, `~` and a hex digit marking its upper-case letters, or `0x` and 8 hex digits. The writer puts one change per line; the reader takes any valid JSON. Keys the codec doesn't know are allowed: it ignores them.

id.description: a custom object's own id: in custom/ only, and there required

base.description: the object it is made from (custom/) or changes (original/)

data.description: its entry in war3map.<ext>; missing: it isn't in that file, {}: it is there without changes

skin.description: its entry in war3mapSkin.<ext>; missing: it isn't in that file, {}: it is there without changes

half.description: the entry as the flat object data file has it, without base and id

end.description: the token after each change, where a change has no `end` of its own; missing means four zero bytes
